name: Button Link
description: Provides a simple button link field formatter.
project_description:
This modules adds a link formatter that transform a link field output in a "button like" Bootstrap anchor.

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 
 Install module as usual: Install contrib modules 
 Load bootstrap library CSS as you wish, usually as part of a theme 
 
 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 
 Goto selected entity view mode and select "Button as Link 
 
 Back to top 

 Advanced 
 All formating is done thru a twig template link-formatter-button-link.html.twig and its preprocess function for extra flexibility.
